definitions.gloss: to come and go; to pass back and forth
definitions.explanation: To move back and forth in different directions, describing multiple people, vehicles, or things passing by one another. Evokes a scene of lively movement and traffic.

examples.english: People come and go along the street.

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大小|だいしょう}→大小：05557_daishou⟧さまざまな⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{交|か}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Ships of all sizes were coming and going in the harbor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{買|か}い{物客|ものきゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{忙|せわ}しなく{行|い}き{交|か}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The shopping district at year's end was bustling with shoppers hurrying back and forth.

notes:
{行|い}き{交|か}う is an intransitive godan verb. A compound of ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go) and {交|か}う (to cross, to intersect).

ASPECT (ている):
{行|い}き{交|か}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes an ongoing scene of people or things moving back and forth.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [person/vehicle]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{交|か}う (people/vehicles pass back and forth)
- [place]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{行|い}き{交|か}う (come and go through a place)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{交|か}う (people come and go)
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{交|か}う (cars pass back and forth)
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{交|か}う (information is exchanged back and forth)

Often used to paint a vivid picture of a busy scene. Can also describe the exchange of messages, emails, or information flying back and forth between parties.
